note: Role is trader, not manufacturer: the customs rows show the company buying finished titanium/stainless/copper goods from Chinese, Swedish and Hong Kong suppliers and re-exporting them to Saudi Arabia, USA, Jordan and UAE — no production evidence. Declared HS 810890 is only partly right: the titanium fittings row is "81089090" ("TITANIUM FITTINGS ELBOW"), but the bulk of the observed trade is 72xx/73xx/74xx (steel coil 72083890, steel tubes 73043119, carbon steel fittings 73079310, copper tube 74111000, nickel-alloy plate 75062000). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with the actual HS range recorded. Discrepancy to flag: the claimed state "Gujarat" does not match the registered address on the customs profile — "2 ND FLOOR, 431,SANGHRAJKA HOUSE, DR DB MARG, OPERA HOUSE, MUMBAI, MAHARASHTRA, 400004" (a second profile lists "42/1, CARPENTER STREET, 2ND FLOOR, OFFICE NO.20, C. P. TANK", also Mumbai). No Gujarat entity of this name was found. Caveat on evidence quality: the free ImportKey view exposes only 5 of 275 (and 5 of 380) rows, so the shipment count is the site's counter, not a count I verified row by row; B/L numbers are as printed by ImportKey and were not cross-checked against a second source (volza, eximpedia, importgenius and trademo all returned 403/JS-challenge, and the web_search backend was unreachable during this session).
